annotations.title: Start the setup the candidate handed you

description: Start or continue the TrueInterview setup the candidate handed you. With the one-time handoff code they pasted (it starts with tih_): redeem it; the code works once, within five minutes of being copied, and only for the account this connection belongs to. Without a code, when the candidate asks to continue their TrueInterview setup: pick up the setup this account left open in an earlier session. Either way returns the setup's steps in order, with a run_code for report_setup_progress; each call issues a new run_code and the earlier one stops working. Keep the code and the run code out of what you write back to the candidate.
name: claim_setup_handoff
title: Start the setup the candidate handed you
